CLAIM: Diagnosability can be represented conditionally on current system state and available hardware.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D04, D05 (robust diagnosability under sensor loss); D42, D14 (mode-dependent hybrid diagnosability); D09 (distinguishability depends on sensors and noise); D11 (conditional isolability, different conditioning)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Diagnosability is defined and verified per sensor set, per mode, under permanent or intermittent sensor loss; a pairwise quantitative distinguishability exists
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: CSIA-DX would index the relation by (sensors, actuators, regime, constraints) jointly at run time; the parts are each indexed in prior art
CSIA_ALREADY_HAS: three-valued predicates (None = not measurable) make availability explicit (D39)
WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_STATUS: none plausible: the concept is textbook in DES and structural diagnosis

CLAIM: Runtime sensor or actuator loss can change the diagnosability relation.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D04, D05, D06, D10; D27 (runtime reasoner treats unavailable tests as unknown)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Diagnosability after permanent sensor loss is a studied property; runtime reasoners already produce the ambiguity groups that result when tests are unavailable
CSIA_ALREADY_HAS: v2 localization already reports unmeasurable predicates and the resulting ambiguity

CLAIM: The system can identify which witness is missing for an unresolved pair.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D07, D08 (which sensors/residuals separate which faults); D28 (flags failures not uniquely identifiable with a sensor set); D01 (critical pairs witness non-diagnosability); D39 (CSIA's competitors_without_witness)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Structural analysis names the residuals and sensors that isolate each pair; commercial tools flag unisolable failures per sensor set; DES verification returns the indistinguishable pair
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: a runtime, reason-tagged explanation (sensor absent / actuator absent / regime outside validity / probe unsafe) per unresolved pair
WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_STATUS: a source that already emits reason-tagged runtime explanations would move it to N0; none seen

CLAIM: The system can identify a minimum evidence set that restores distinguishability.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D07, D08 (minimal sensor sets); D26 (minimum-cost test sequencing); D25 (next best measurement); D24 (cost-aware active sensing); D39 (CSIA's minimum_resolving_subsets)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Minimal sensor sets and minimum-cost test selection are solved or approximated (weighted set cover; NP-complete optimal trees)
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: none beyond applying it to the currently missing witnesses
CSIA_ALREADY_HAS: minimum_resolving_subsets (retrospective over measured predicates; not prospective over missing ones)

CLAIM: The system can identify active actions that generate the missing evidence.
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Active diagnosis designs inputs or controllable events to make faults distinguishable, including on spacecraft (on-board control procedures) and quadrotors (excitation, null-space probing)

CLAIM: Active evidence acquisition can be constrained by the current safe operating envelope.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D03 (active safe diagnosis), D17 (constrained AFD), D18 (isolability-guaranteeing input under state constraints), D20 (s-FEAST: informative actions with probabilistic state constraints), D21 (safe real-time AFD via reachability), D22 (quadrotor safety controller)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Several formulations enforce state/input/probabilistic safety constraints while choosing informative inputs, online, including aerospace

CLAIM: The system can explicitly represent when safe evidence acquisition is impossible.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D03 (necessary and sufficient conditions for safe diagnosability); D17, D18 (infeasibility of the constrained input design); D20 (safety dominates information in the planner)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Infeasibility of safe active diagnosis is implicit (no admissible input) or a verified property (safe diagnosability conditions)
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: an explicit runtime output state NOT_SEPARABLE_NOW with reason PROBE_UNSAFE and the retained ambiguity
CSIA_ALREADY_HAS: AMBIGUOUS verdict preserves the candidate set
WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_STATUS: a planner that already outputs an explicit 'cannot safely resolve' state would move it to N0

CLAIM: Action authority can depend on the unresolved hypothesis set.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D31 (runtime assurance), D30 (capability assessment for contingency management), D20, D32 (belief-space safe control), D38 (switching among candidate controllers), D44 (health score gating reconfiguration)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Actions are restricted by estimated capability, belief or health confidence; controllers are chosen robust to candidate faults
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: authority computed as the intersection of actions acceptable under every hypothesis in each unresolved class (a minimax rule over a discrete ambiguity set)
CSIA_ALREADY_HAS: functions.py eligibility; the layer issues no command
WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_STATUS: an IVHM or RTA source with an explicit ambiguity-set intersection rule would move it to N0

CLAIM: The same diagnosability representation can support design-time sensor architecture and runtime reasoning.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D27 (TEAMS-Designer and TEAMS-RT on one multi-signal model), D28 (MADe sensor-set design generating diagnostic rules), D12 (one structural model for isolability, sensor placement and residual generation), D13 (joint sensor placement and online diagnosis)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Industry tools already carry one model from testability analysis to an on-board runtime reasoner
CSIA_ALREADY_HAS: the v2 signature matrix is used at design time (Phase C) and run time

CLAIM: The integrated combination (runtime conditional diagnosability + missing witness + minimum evidence + safe active acquisition + ambiguity-dependent authority + design/runtime reuse) provides a capability not supplied by existing IVHM/FDI/RTA systems.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D20 (closest runtime loop), D14/D15 (diagnosability-guided active diagnosis on board), D27 (design-to-runtime reuse), D03 (active safe diagnosis), D30 (capability assessment)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: The runtime loop (belief over faults, informative safe actions) exists in s-FEAST; diagnosability-guided active diagnosis exists; design-to-runtime reuse exists; capability-bounded contingency management exists
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: no single searched source was seen to combine all six with an explicit pairwise separability state, reason-tagged missing witnesses and an ambiguity-set authority rule; no emergent capability is shown, and the assembly is a straightforward composition
WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_STATUS: full text of D20, D14, D15, D27 could show the integration (then N1); a demonstrated capability the composition has and the parts lack could raise it

CLAIM: The runtime relation can be computed within embedded budgets from precomputed, availability-indexed pair masks.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D33 (compiled onboard diagnosis), D27 (embedded runtime reasoner)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Onboard diagnosis by knowledge compilation and embedded D-matrix reasoning are established
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: a specific bitset layout for pairwise separability indexed by availability and regime
CSIA_ALREADY_HAS: set elimination is already deterministic and cheap

CLAIM: A predictive, evidence-independent separability status per pair can be maintained at run time, distinct from the diagnostic result.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D07, D08, D26, D27 (design-time isolability for a given test set), D06 (runtime sensor activation preserving diagnosability)
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Isolability for a given sensor/test set is computed at design time; runtime sensor activation policies are designed to preserve diagnosability
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: recomputing that design-time property for the currently surviving set at every change

CLAIM: A probe is admissible only if it is safe under every hypothesis still in the candidate set.
CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART: D18 (constraints guaranteed for all fault modes), D20 (probabilistic constraints under the fault belief), D03
WHAT_PRIOR_ART_ALREADY_DOES: Robust and chance-constrained active diagnosis already require safety across fault modes or beliefs
RESIDUAL_DIFFERENCE: the discrete, set-valued form over the unresolved class
